//: Copy to agenthook.config.json in your project dir (or run `agenthook init`).
//secrets: Secrets are ${ENV} refs, resolved from the shell or a .env beside this file,
//secrets2: so this file stays shareable. State lives centrally in ~/.agenthook/<name>.
name: myproject
//fullAuto: false (safe default) = privileged tool calls are denied (headless agents cannot prompt) unless a step allow policy permits them. true = --dangerously-skip-permissions: a verified webhook runs UNSANDBOXED code on the host. Opt in only on a trusted host or in a container. See docs/architecture.md#security-posture.
//harnesses: Optional: named agent backends, each with its own slot pool (maxConcurrent). A step's "harness" (a name or a list, with "routing": first-free | round-robin) picks one with a free slot when the job starts; the step's own agent/model/bin/env win. Rename to "harnesses" to enable. See docs/local-models.md#several-backends-harnesses.

tracker.//: type selects the adapter; the rest is that tracker's config.
tracker.//github: GitHub Issues instead: { type:'github', repository:'owner/name', token:'${GITHUB_TOKEN}' } — steps bind labels (sourceLabel/successLabel/...). See docs/github-setup.md.
tracker.//github-projects: GitHub Projects v2 instead: { type:'github-projects', project:'owner/number', token:'${GITHUB_TOKEN}' } — steps bind board Status options (sourceStatus/successStatus/..., like Jira). ORG webhook + STABLE ingress required. See docs/github-projects-setup.md.
tracker.//displayIdField: Optional (Asana): name of the custom field holding the task's human id (e.g. ID-1234) shown by `ah agents`/`status`/`events`. Default "ID"; no match = the raw gid.
tracker.//pipeline: The execution model (required). A task ENTERING a step's sourceSectionGid fires
tracker.//pipeline2: that step. On exit the agent writes a VERDICT and the receiver moves the task:
tracker.//pipeline3: advance -> successSectionGid (= the next step's source, so the move triggers it);
tracker.//pipeline4: fail -> failureSectionGid (non-zero exit, or the agent says so); hold -> holdSectionGid
tracker.//pipeline5: (parked for a human answer); changes -> a prior step's source (the rework loop, capped
tracker.//pipeline6: by maxAttempts, default 3). createsWorktree makes the receiver own a git worktree
tracker.//pipeline7: shared across the task's steps; drainWorktree removes it; manual = no agent (entry
tracker.//pipeline8: only runs system actions). Each step's instructionsFile is its standing prompt.
tracker.//pipeline9: Forward motion is all event-driven; `agenthook reconcile` is the only (explicit) poll.

pipeline.//lite: optional: cheaper model/effort when the ticket already has a full spec — every heading must start a line of the description. Triage still runs. Rename to `lite` to enable.
pipeline.//holdSectionGid: optional: where a `hold` parks a task waiting on a human answer

pipeline.//maxAttempts: optional: cap on runs per task before a `changes` loop into this step fails (default 3)
pipeline.//maxMinutes: optional: wall-clock cap on one run; past it the agent is killed and the run fails with `timeout` (default 120, 0 = off)
pipeline.//idleMinutes: optional, default off: also kill the agent after this many minutes with no output

pipeline.//effort: optional: per-step `claude -p --effort` (low|medium|high|xhigh|max). Spend tokens where they matter — e.g. low/medium for triage/review, high for code. Omit = CLI default.
pipeline.//changes: a review `changes` verdict bounces back to the previous step (code) on the same branch/PR

//forge: Optional: complete tasks when their agent/<ref> PR merges. { type:'github', repository:'owner/name', token: a GITHUB_TOKEN env ref } + one manual step with completeOnMerge:true. See docs/asana-setup.md#completing-tasks-on-merge-forge.
//forgeAutoMerge: Optional (github forge, off by default): add autoMerge to the forge block to auto-merge a PR once the approving step (default: the last review step; or set step) advances with an allowed risk tier (summary.tier of that verdict, or of tierFrom): the receiver marks the PR ready and enables GitHub auto-merge; only the PR head the tier step judged can merge, and a later changes/fail or a new commit turns it off. method: squash (default) | merge | rebase. See docs/configuration.md#auto-merge-on-review-approval-forgeautomerge.

ingress.//: How the receiver is reachable. ngrok (managed tunnel) | manual/hosted (static URL).
ingress.//domain: optional reserved domain for a stable URL (omit = ephemeral)
ingress.//manual: For a hosted URL instead: { type: hosted, url: https://hook.you.com }
